title: Direct Instruction

**Theme ID:** `direct-instruction`

## Summary

Direct Instruction provides clear, structured explanations with modeled examples, followed by guided practice and independent application. The instructor controls the sequence and pace. This is the appropriate style when learners need explicit knowledge transfer before they can engage productively in more open activities.

## Token Defaults

```yaml
scaffolding.level: high
agency.mode: fixed-path
feedback.mode: instructor
assessment.evidence: quiz
revision.required: false
reflection.required: false
collaboration.structure: individual
```

## Preferred Patterns

- [`demo-guided-practice-independent-production`](/patterns/demo-guided-practice-independent-production/)
- [`mastery-checkpoint-pathway`](/patterns/mastery-checkpoint-pathway/)

## Best For

- Technical skill introduction
- Knowledge transfer (terminology, concepts, procedures)
- Prerequisite skill building before open-ended projects
- Learners who need explicit instruction before exploration

## AI Guidance

When applying this theme, keep the sequence controlled and predictable. Generate clear explanations with worked examples before any learner task. Include comprehension checks. Avoid ambiguous instructions — learners in a direct instruction context expect clarity about what to do and how.
